analysis.visual_description: On the board. Two orchard sheets by a rush-light, the stone not here, a hand flat on the margin.
On the board. The same sheets, the rush-light lower, the second line as it was written in the garden. Nothing is added in this room.
On the board. The sheets squared and set under the wallet. The rush-light still burning. The tables from midday are shut. No new line on either.
